line: Everyone talks in your chair. What do they say about Dez?
reply: People got a lot to say 'bout everyone, Dez included. I just try to listen and cut their hair real good.

event: The Harbor Bar is full and loud and for a few hours nothing is wrong.

name: Booker Lyle
action: Washes money in the back room, alone
thought: Another day, another dollar. Lyle Pawn & Loan keeps thriving.

name: Cass Deveaux
action: Strolls around The Vacant Lot, observing the area
thought: I need to keep an eye on Booker. He's been acting shifty lately.

name: Dez Okonkwo
action: Counts the day's earnings in the laundromat's office
thought: I need to lay low for now, see how things play out.

name: Ms. Ivy Calloway
action: Prepares the day's inventory at Calloway's Corner
thought: I'll have to keep an eye on Cass. They seem interested in buying up property.

name: Junie Marsh
action: Wipes down the counter at The Blue Spoon
thought: Adeyemi's always been a steady rock. I'm glad she's here.

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: Tries to focus on the day's paperwork at the 9th Precinct
thought: I need to come up with a plan to pay back that loan. I'm in way over my head.

name: Malik Reyes
action: Paces around the block outside Terrace Block B
thought: Okonkwo's got connections, no doubt about it. I need to get in with him.

name: Nadia Vasquez
action: Studies for school at The Vasquez House
thought: I need to stay focused and keep my head down. My dad's situation is precarious.

name: Rey Vasquez
action: Tackles a small repair job at Vasquez Auto Body
thought: I need to keep my business separate from my... other activities.

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: Goes over case files with Ofc. Kohl at the 9th Precinct
thought: I need to trust my instincts. Kohl's got good instincts.

name: Simone Adeyemi
action: Reviews patient charts at Halloway Clinic
thought: I need to stop bending the truth and just tell it like it is.

name: Tariq 'Tee' Bello
action: Cuts hair for a customer at Tee's Barbershop
thought: I love hearing all the stories in this chair. People are good at telling them.
